title: MiCAR Register Change Record v1
description: One line of data/changelog.jsonl (and one item of recent_changes in docs/feed.json). Covers record_version 1 (records up to the 2026-10-12 snapshot) and 2; fields added with version 2 are optional because version 1 records lack them. Field meanings: docs/data-dictionary.md.

change.description: Version 1 records use added, changed, removed and baseline; version 2 adds missing and restored, and its removed means absent from two consecutive exports.

entry_id.description: The row's entry identity; "-" on baseline records.

subtypes.description: Mechanical labels; see docs/data-dictionary.md for the values written so far. New labels may be added.
